messages:
julia-cs: Customer tenant_839 reporting intermittent 5xx (Gateway 504/502) during onboarding ramp. ~15% of first-request traffic failing, most errors between 12:14:50–12:15:20 UTC. Escalating.
support-bot: Alert: elevated 5xx rate for tenant_839 /v1/generate — 18/min spike at 2026-03-16T12:15:00Z. Incident channel auto-created.
ben-sre: Acknowledged. Any repro steps or sample request IDs? New tenant?
julia-cs: New tenant — onboarded yesterday. They ran a short high-concurrency warmup script (50 concurrent). Sample traces: 2026-03-16T12:14:55Z -> 504, 12:15:03Z -> 502, 12:15:18Z -> success. They also saw earlier auth failures during billing cutover but that was resolved.
alice-ops: Looking at infra: I see HPA/ScaledObject activity around 12:14:50 but new pods stuck in ContainerCreating / Init ~18s. Readiness never passed before some requests hit. Model init logs show heavy weight download + quant step ~15–20s for this model.
charlie-eng: Can we paste HPA + ScaledObject config + deploy events? Suspect KEDA polling cadence + cooldown too conservative, so scale reaction missed the burst.
matt-platform: Ran commands:
```
kubectl -n hosted get scaledobject tenant-839-scaled -o yaml
kubectl -n hosted describe deploy tenant-839-deploy
kubectl -n hosted logs deploy/tenant-839-deploy --since=2h | grep -i "model init"
```
ben-sre: From outputs: ScaledObject pollInterval=30s, cooldownPeriod=300s, no activation annotation (defaults to 0). Metric is queueLength sampled every poll. Queue jumped to ~120 at 12:14:40 but KEDA only observed at next poll 12:15:10 -> scale triggered, pod scheduling after that -> model init complete ~12:15:38. Several requests between 12:14:40–12:15:18 timed out.
julia-cs: So summary: client ramp created queue spike, KEDA poll cadence missed the spike, pods were cold (0 minReplicas) causing slow model init -> early requests hit gateways and timed out.
sara-customer: (DM from customer) they used our quickstart ramp and tweaked it to be aggressive; they thought it was fine. They're okay with a workaround but want ETA.
charlie-eng: Mitigations proposed:
- reduce ScaledObject pollInterval to 10s and cooldown to 120s for onboarding tier
- set scaledobject.keda.sh/activation to 20 to force earlier activation
- bump minReplicas from 0->1 for tenant group or enable prewarm hooks
- add readinessProbe initialDelaySeconds=5, timeoutSeconds=60 to avoid readiness flaps during init
Also consider routing to a smaller model variant as fallback during scale.
alice-ops: I can apply a quick infra patch for tenant_839: pollInterval=10s, cooldown=120s, activation=20, minReplicas=1. Patching now and will monitor metrics.
matt-platform: Also offering a temporary move to our warm pool (dedicated burst pool) — ETA ~12m if customer accepts.
ben-sre: Please add alert: queue growth >80 for any tenant with minReplicas=0 and HPA Pending >2 to catch this earlier.
support-bot: Patch applied by alice-ops at 2026-03-16T12:22:10Z.
alice-ops: Post-patch telemetry: later spike at 12:27 observed, scaled pods ready by ~12:27:18 (lag ~8s). Error rate fell from ~15% -> ~1.2% in the 15m after patch.
sara-customer: Customer accepted fallback to smaller model; migration started, they reported one final 504 during cutover but now stable.
charlie-eng: Root cause list: (1) KEDA pollInterval/cooldown too long for bursty onboards, (2) 0 minReplicas + heavy model init (weights+quant) => long cold start, (3) aggressive customer ramping. Action items assigned: infra default pollInterval=10s for onboarding (alice/matt), platform prewarm toggle + per-tenant minReplicas control (charlie), update onboarding docs + ramp recommendations (julia), SRE alert for queue growth/HPA pending (ben).
ben-sre: I'll create a tracking ticket and link this thread. Will keep monitoring for 24h.
julia-cs: I'll update the customer and keep this open until 24h stable post-migration. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
